headline: A trading-bot company allegedly forged its own SEC certificate to convince investors it was real — the bots never existed

sources.title: SEC Charges Multiple Entities in Fraud Schemes Totaling at Least $15 Million That Used WhatsApp, Other Platforms

summary: On 29 September 2026 the SEC filed a civil fraud complaint (SDNY) against TSAI Pro Ltd. and TSAI Capital Foundation, alleging they invited investors to "rent" AI trading bots for fees of $100 to $500,000, promoted via a website, WhatsApp and Facebook with a recruitment-commission structure. The SEC alleges TSAI posted a falsified SEC regulatory certificate and a fabricated Form D filing to look officially registered — no bots and no real trading ever existed. About $2.8 million was raised from roughly 1,715 investors between September 2024 and March 2025. This is a civil complaint, not a criminal charge: nothing has been proven in court and no individual has been named or convicted.
